description: This file is a header (.h) file for Ralink RT3050 Ethernet switch driver in the Linux kernel. It declares initialization and cleanup functions, as well as functions to operate the switch hardware, conditioned on the CONFIG_NET_RALINK_ESW_RT3052 configuration.

methods.name: int __init mtk_switch_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the Ralink RT3052 Ethernet switch if the configuration is enabled.

methods.name: void mtk_switch_exit(void)
methods.description: Cleans up the Ralink RT3052 Ethernet switch if the configuration is enabled.

methods.name: rt3050_esw_init
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet switch with provided private data.

methods.name: rt3050_esw_has_carrier
methods.description: Checks if the Ethernet switch has a carrier.
